comment: Initial load counts the app entry and every transitive static JavaScript import, plus the app stylesheet. terminal is the single xterm.js chunk loaded on a mission page (its stylesheet is a separate file the chunk loads). routes is the sum of the other lazily loaded chunks: login, reset, account, workers, sessions, usage and diagnostics (lazyRoutes lists one string of each route module, which must be absent from the initial graph and present in a lazy chunk). The initial JavaScript and CSS caps are those of D17; the routes cap is interim and is re-measured after WP-5 (D18). Sizes are bytes; gzip level 9 approximates a compressing proxy.

lazyRoutes.workers: A worker runs missions on a machine
